add_charger.title: Add charger
add_charger.description: Choose the charger to add. Only Easee devices not already configured are shown. Your existing charger and its settings are kept. Enable its Easee Voltage sensor before continuing. The integration reloads and automatic control starts off. {validation_error}

remove_charger.title: Remove charger
remove_charger.description: Choose the charger to remove. The other charger and household settings are kept. SLM first sends 0 A to the removed charger. Its settings are saved if you add it again later. {validation_error}
